docs.summary: Line at a time lexer. Line based state is what lets the editor highlight only the visible part of a huge file: a line's colours depend only on its text and the state the previous line ended in.

members.name: Tokenize
members.signature: int Tokenize(string line, int state, List<CodeToken>? tokens)

docs.summary: Lexes `line` starting in `state` and returns the state the next line starts in. Must be stateless and thread safe, since folding runs it on a background thread while the editor draws. `tokens` is null when the editor only needs the end state, so the lexer can skip emitting.
